IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[DIM_Paciente_Patologia]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = '[dbo]')
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[DIM_Paciente_Patologia]
	(
	 [ID_DIMPaciente_Patologia] int,
	 [ID_PacientePatologia] bigint,
	 [ID_Paciente] bigint,
	 [ID_Patologia] bigint,
	 [NOMBRE_PATOLOGIA] nvarchar(4000)
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

COPY INTO [dbo].[DIM_Paciente_Patologia]

FROM 'https://azpaciencareetl.dfs.core.windows.net/datosprocesados/dw/DIM_PacientePatologia.parquet'

	,MAXERRORS = 0
